As the text summarization task has gained wide attention in factuality evaluations, which measure whether the model's outputs are faithful to the source document, we instantiate our active learning framework to address LLM hallucinations in generated summaries.

To evaluate the performance of our methods, we use the three hallucination detection metrics as introduced in Section 4.2: FactKB for semantic frame, UniEval for discourse, and BERT-P for content verifiability. In addition, we also measure the ROUGE-L score to assess the quality of generated summaries.
